criteria.criterion: Cost units, measured versus estimated/provider costs, cache state, hardware and precision are explicit.
criteria.explanation: Every source_usage and phase_total cell names its unit (seconds, cpu_seconds, gpu_seconds, provider_units, gibibytes) and observation kind (measured, estimated, provider, unmeasured). CPU seconds are never inferred from wall time. Provider call counts stay labeled provider. Hardware/precision/cache_state are present on usage and phase rows: sealed CPU with unused or sample_memory cache; AF-009 packed_cpu float32; CUDA precision unmeasured. Sealed-PATH probe recorded nvidia-smi unusable, torch/numpy absent, and cuda_available false.

criteria.criterion: Phase totals reconcile with retained run/usage records, including setup and failures.
criteria.explanation: CostLedger summed 49 retained usage rows, including seven setup command residuals/logs and failure rows from AF-009 packed-CPU exits and AF-018 assistance/proof-reconstruction attempts. Measured elapsed is 481.588608018s on both the per-record sum and the twelve-phase catalog; the independent usage sum matches. Annotation, features, indexing, model-call GPU/service time, and review remain unmeasured rather than filled with zeros. check_outputs confirmed includes_setup and includes_failures.

criteria.criterion: Any throughput/speedup is based on matched actual runs; unavailable hardware is not a zero-cost result.
criteria.explanation: The only measured ratio is AF-011 T0 codec replay 1 versus replay 2 on matched CPU python-backend identity (about 1.021x), labeled as not a CUDA speedup. CPU-versus-CUDA, cold/warm residency, and fp16/fp32 GPU comparisons are unmeasured with value null. gpu_cost_from_observation(0.0, cuda_available=False) returns unmeasured/null; matched_throughput without a CUDA actual run does not emit 0.0s or 1.0x. nvidia-smi cannot talk to a driver in the sealed environment.
